exclusion_reason: The human and AI-agent contribution pipeline is implemented: an agent PR without an AI-use disclosure is refused before the gate, and a disclosed-agent PR and a human PR take the byte-identical gate path. The benchmark stays red because the gate itself cannot prove a browser game runtime behaves — only that the contribution process is uniform.
promotion_trigger: Promote when an agent PR and a human PR pass through the identical gate with disclosure recorded.
expected_failing_assertion: No authorship-disclosure rule exists in the contribution path.
active_gate_evidence: test/governance.test.mjs asserts an undisclosed agent PR is refused and that a disclosed-agent PR and a human PR resolve to the identical gate path.
procedure: Open a drill agent PR without disclosure and assert refusal.
Open the same PR with disclosure and assert the full gate applies.
Open a human PR and assert the identical gate path.
pass_criterion: Both PR class pass the identical gate.
